assessment.reason:
Independent read-only assessment. The subject is worksite 365d2ed2b plus the attempt009 candidate diff (Construction Result 1529b9) and C2 Testing Result bff801. The declared candidate file, release-claim.md (sha256:841b8c59…, which matches), is the unchanged rc.3 claim text. It does not describe attempt009, so I assessed the actual diff and the admitted Results. The digests of all mandatory sources and of rubric.DRAFT.json (094827…) match the declared basis.

The full outcome is not met. R2, the original predecessor-Run part of R1/R3 and native exact recovery are unrealized. The Worker reports this, and the source confirms it.

What the evidence establishes:

(1) R3 C2 producer-coordinate repair is satisfied at component level.
- invocation_admission.ts deriveSameRunWorksiteCommandSourceBasisAtPrefix now rederives a native source Result under the producer's own invocation admission and Run, source.sourceBasis.invocationAdmissionRef and sourceResult.runId. The reacquisition-only conditional is gone.
- In the same-Run non-retained arm, projectSameRunNativeWorkCommandSourceAtPrefix already requires the producer invocation and Run to equal the consumer's, so behaviour there is unchanged.
- Consumer parent call, single grant, binding and currentness checks are unchanged. Reacquisition is not forced.
- All three callers (execution_basis.ts:994 and :2520, replay.ts:2043) go through this single owner.
- The new test in t287-native-worksite-execution adds wrong-digest, wrong-call, no-row, no-source-use, foreign-binding, missing-parent and stale-write controls. It passes in bff801 focused-owner-chain. scratch09/logs/r1-baseline-365.log shows it failing on 365 at the 008 assertion.
- Limits: invocation/basis lookup, hasExactInvocationRunBinding and the Run replay guard are stubbed. The stale control is not isolated to currentness. No real 008 prefix or installed fresh-retained Run was reproduced. C2 execution, fold, selection, UAT, parent closure and result/replay after C2 admission in that scenario are unproven.

(2) R1/R3 same-Run behaviour is conserved, but the original obligation is not.
- The existing installed default-library pending-Testing test passes in bff801 affected-owner-tests: SIGKILL at the entered Testing cursor with openedAtInterruption 0, then a cold Public pending_execution resume, with one Construction and select→native→select→c2→select→assess, 318→633 events.
- The recursive cold Public, one-use, duplicate and mixed-arm tests also pass.
- The proof limit is explicit: same-Run only, with a scripted model.
- No predecessor-Run pending-Testing integration was built. The entryRouteRef route-only target and active-dispatch effect_unknown recovery remain residuals.

(3) R2 is unmet.
- event_prefix.ts is byte-unchanged from HEAD. Line 939 still refuses every other-Run holder as foreign.
- No source-use or pending-use relation was threaded into the resolver. There is no authenticated predecessor body use and no exact pending-frontier recovery proof.
- The Worker says the blocker is authority: the only cross-Run consumer is the selector reader at instruction_assembly.ts:422, which is outside the write grant, and current_intent topology expansion is excluded. Code inspection supports this in part: the default_library.ts:98 and :125 readers pass the current {runId}. I did not verify that no in-grant topology could reach a foreign holder.
- This gap needs Root to admit that reader or decide the topology.

(4) R4 is mostly satisfied.
- The pendingPreparations WeakSet was write-only in 365 (add only, no reader) and is removed.
- The coordinate rule is merged into one owner rule. The survivors (construction_intent, selected_action, same-Run pending_execution) are justified in the HOW docs. The event-family correction was already present in 365.
- No new engine, store, event family, failure code or telemetry was added. instruction_assembly.ts was not written. All changed paths are inside the grant.
- Both generated outputs differ from HEAD only in digest values, and their productContentDigest d1c3d0bc… equals the bff801 package output.
- Residual: the audit for displaced duplicate pending reconstruction was not done.

(5) R5's C2 part is satisfied.
- All nine commands exit 0 within budget, and all twelve predicates hold: pass counts 114, 104 and 2, failures 0.
- The 12 and 6 skips are all environment-gated. The only test change is an addition, so there is no new skip and no weakened assertion.
- source-correspondence hashes match the candidate bytes.
- The ENOENT text in command 0 is cat output of the retained RC2 fixture (bee000…), not a test of this candidate.
